name: EMCC
recent: EMCC 在2026年10月获得四张典当牌照，将业务扩展至东马。公司于2026年9月派发每股0.6仙的中期股息，并因员工行使ESOS期权而发行新股。最新财报显示2026年6月季度营收环比下降12%，但净利环比微增1.1%。
notable: 获得四张典当牌照，进军东马市场。
宣布每股0.6仙中期股息，除息日为2026年9月8日。
因员工行使ESOS期权，发行约101万股新股。
risks: 首席执行官行使ESOS期权，持股可能增加。
ESOS新股发行可能造成轻微股权摊薄。
earnings: 2026年6月季度营收为5949万令吉，环比下降12.0%，同比上升21.9%；净利为1386.5万令吉，环比上升1.1%，同比上升49.6%；净利率为23.3%，高于上季度的20.3%。

recent_en: EMCC secured four pawnbroking licences in October 2026 to expand into East Malaysia. The company paid an interim dividend of 0.6 sen per share in September 2026 and issued new shares from ESOS option exercises. The latest quarterly results showed a 12% QoQ revenue decline but a 1.1% QoQ net profit increase for the quarter ended June 2026.
notable_en: Secured four pawnbroking licences to enter the East Malaysian market.
Declared an interim dividend of 0.6 sen per share with ex-date on 8 September 2026.
Issued approximately 1.01 million new shares from ESOS option exercises.
risks_en: The CEO exercised ESOS options, which may increase her shareholding.
The ESOS new share issuance may cause slight equity dilution.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was MYR 59.49 million, down 12.0% QoQ but up 21.9% YoY; net profit was MYR 13.865 million, up 1.1% QoQ and up 49.6% YoY; net margin was 23.3%, higher than 20.3% in the previous quarter.
